decision.reason: Halving V-stage barriers is byte-exact but improves the leaf only 0.44%. Double buffering raises static LDS by 16 KiB and clang allocates 224 rather than 104 VGPRs under both copy schedules. Synchronization-only ping-pong is not a material path on this body.
decision.next: Keep the retained single buffer and 32-block ownership. The next material attention design must increase arithmetic per ownership/load event, following llama.cpp's cooperative-matrix GQA reuse, while preserving or independently bounding Laguna quality.
